cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Credit for the Discovery
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you found the clue, saw through the deception, or designed the successful scheme.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: In the report about the missing raffle money, put that I found the deposit receipt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've written that the team traced the payment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tracing isn't finding. You followed the payment after I found the receipt. Keep those jobs separate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. I'll list your name first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First in a list doesn't say what I did. 'Receipt found by', then my name. You can thank the team underneath.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 seeks named credit for finding the deposit receipt. A3 corrects B2's merged job description; A5 corrects B4's list-position concession into a precise finding attribution.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 team tracing claim is separated into finding versus tracing in A3. B4 offers first position, which A5 rejects as failing to identify A's actual discovery.

relationship.evidence: B2 values the team's contribution and B4 offers a compromise, each a credible editorial response to A's request.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4's apparently generous recognition into another technically inadequate draft requiring A's expert correction.

specificity.evidence: A1 now names missing raffle money and deposit receipt, supplying the practical discovery absent from the original.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's found-by instruction gives B an exact usable edit and its status-conscious ordering grows from B4's list proposal.
